'''Elzian''' was an [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] who served in the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]] as a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]]. Around [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], Colonel Elzian participated in a [[Battle of Pallaxides|battle]] against the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pallaxides]]. During the battle, the [[Officer/Legends|officer]] was stationed aboard a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Unidentified MC80 Liberty type Star Cruiser (Pallaxides)|MC80 ''Liberty'' type Star Cruiser]], under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].

Elzian reported with confidence that the battle would result in a definite New Republic victory, and later expressed concern for General Solo's wellbeing, as the latter had stood watch over the fighting for nearly forty-eight [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] without [[Sleep/Legends|sleep]]. The colonel successfully persuaded Solo to rest, although circumstances soon turned to prevent the general from having his much-needed break.

==Biography==
{{Quote|General Solo, it looks as though our victory is complete. The Imperial forces are clearly trapped in an untenable position.|Elzian speaks to Han Solo|<ref name="Empire Lost 3" />}}
Holding the rank of [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] in the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]], Elzian was aboard [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]]<ref name="Empire Lost 3" /> [[Unidentified MC80 Liberty type Star Cruiser (Pallaxides)|MC80 ''Liberty'' type Star Cruiser]]<ref name="Liberty">[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> during the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Battle of Pallaxides|battle]] against [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] forces over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pallaxides]] around [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]]. As Solo, who had stood watch over the battle for nearly forty-eight [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]], remained fixated on the contested world through a [[Viewport/Legends|viewport]] on his [[Star Cruiser/Legends|Star Cruiser's]] [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], Colonel Elzian reported to the [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] of their apparent victory, giving a brief assessment of the battle; Elzian was certain of their opponent's defeat, remarking that their forces were evidently and decisively trapped. Han Solo agreed, although he was unsatisfied of the Imperials' intent of fighting to their [[Death/Legends|deaths]], stating his aversion to creating unnecessary casualties.<ref name="Empire Lost 3" />

[[File:MC80_bridge.jpg|thumb|left|330px|Elzian (right) participated at the battle of Pallaxides.]]
Turning to the colonel, Han Solo ordered the retreat of naval forces and the deployment of ground forces. Colonel Elzian then began to remind General Solo of his lack of rest, though Solo interrupted to acknowledge his subordinate's concern. The general thus relinquished command of the Republic's forces to Elzian and proceeded to his own living quarters for [[Sleep/Legends|sleep]]. Before Solo could rest, however, he was contacted via [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] by a [[Unidentified New Republic officer (Pallaxides)|Republic officer]] who exclaimed that the general was needed in the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] command center, eliminating Solo's chance for rest.<ref name="Empire Lost 3" /> Nevertheless, the battle over Pallaxides was won by the New Republic as enemy forces eventually capitulated.<ref name="Empire Lost 4">[[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 4|''Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost'' 4]]</ref>

==Personality and traits==
An [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]], Elzian had [[Color/Legends|green]] skin and a pair of yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. During the battle of Pallaxides, the colonel expressed concern for the New Republic forces' commanding [[Officer/Legends|officer]], General Han Solo, after the [[Human/Legends|Human]] had stood watch over the battle for nearly forty-eight hours.<ref name="Empire Lost 3" />

==Equipment==
Along with a pair of dark blue-gray footwear, Elzian wore a dark blue [[Clothing/Legends|robe]] with a gold trim. The garb was visually similar to the decorated light blue outfits of bridge personnel serving aboard Han Solo's<ref name="Empire Lost 3" /> [[MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 ''Liberty'' type Star Cruiser]].<ref name="Liberty" />

==Behind the scenes==
Elzian appears in the [[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 3|third issue]] of [[Star Wars: Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost|''Empire Lost'']], the third mini-series of the [[Star Wars: Crimson Empire (series)|''Star Wars: Crimson Empire'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book series]].<ref name="Empire Lost 3" /> Published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[December 28]], [[2011]],<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54053/star_wars_crimson_empire_iii_-_empire_lost_2011_3|text=Star Wars: Crimson Empire III - Empire Lost (2011) #3}}</ref> ''Empire Lost'' 3 was written by [[Mike Richardson]], penciled by [[Paul Gulacy]], and colored by [[Michael Bartolo]].<ref name="Empire Lost 3" />
